meta.title: Ticking several items of the same PR gives the same list as one item

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area required by the case.
Stay on the Open tab, where PR-1 can be selected for assignment.

args.goal: Find PR-1 with its 3 items, select one item, open Assign using the person icon next to Upload PRs, record the names in the Search a user list, close it, select the other two PR-1 items, open Assign again, compare the names with the first list, and leave the second Search a user list open showing that both lists are identical.

steps.note: Perform and verify the item-selection and assignee-list comparison that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Assert that the final assignee search list remains open on the expected Search a user control.
